bajan: "De Bajan man him say," Ella smiled, "'plantain an' salt fish me don't want 'um, an' de Mud-head man him say, me wish me had 'um, me wish me had 'um....
An' we go to wah-- We shall carry de name, Bajan boys for--evah!
Yo' ain't gwine wine no mo' fi' suit any big teet' Bajan."
But one man, a Bajan creole, did whip up the courage of voice.
Bajan gal don't wash 'ar skin Till de rain come down....
